Visitor schedule
The Harbor Workshop opens at 09:00 and closes at 18:00.
Lin is responsible for the daily opening checklist.
Group visits must be registered one day in advance.
Harbor Workshop / Demonstration handbook / 1

Equipment checklist
Inspect all 24 adjustable lamps before each exhibition.
Check lamp quantities, colour temperature reports and warranty files.
Store the two-year warranty files in the equipment archive.
Harbor Workshop / Demonstration handbook / 2

Closing handover
Before closing, count all lamps and check the power switches.
Attach the inspection photographs to the handover record.
Record unresolved issues and notify the next shift supervisor.
Harbor Workshop / Demonstration handbook / 3
